name: Android Dev Container
postCreateCommand: bash -c 'sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y openjdk-17-jdk wget unzip && mkdir -p /opt/android-sdk/cmdline-tools && wget -q https://dl.google.com/android/repository/commandlinetools-linux-11076708_latest.zip -O /tmp/cmdline-tools.zip && unzip -q /tmp/cmdline-tools.zip -d /opt/android-sdk/cmdline-tools && mv /opt/android-sdk/cmdline-tools/cmdline-tools /opt/android-sdk/cmdline-tools/latest && rm /tmp/cmdline-tools.zip && sudo chown -R vscode:vscode /opt/android-sdk && yes | /opt/android-sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager --licenses || true && /opt/android-sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager "platforms;android-34" "build-tools;34.0.0"'
